description: Copy a file or a whole folder inside your workspace. Parent folders of to are created; links are copied as links. Nothing is copied if to already exists (FileBad). Returns JSON {from, to, counter_files}. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, FileBad, CopyFailed.

from.description: source path, relative to your workspace

to.description: full destination path (not the folder to copy into)
